measurements.directive: meas tran resistor_p_max MAX V(in,out)*I(R1) FROM=0u TO=400u
measurements.description: Instantaneous dissipation in R1 must stay within the specified 20 mW check limit.

measurements.directive: meas tran vout_100u FIND V(out) AT=100u
meas tran rms_resistor_current RMS I(R1) FROM=0u TO=400u
measurements.description: RMS resistor current over the startup window.

measurements.directive: meas tran resistor_p_average AVG V(in,out)*I(R1) FROM=0u TO=400u
measurements.description: Average resistor dissipation over the startup window.

measurements.directive: meas tran vout_short_window_peak MAX V(out) FROM=0u TO=10u
measurements.description: Output peak in the first 10 microseconds.
